capture_coverage_denominator: frozen eligible incidents in bug-corpus.json; failures count, never reclassified as unsupported because Rapture failed

corpus_policy.commit_only: manifests, URLs, SHAs, hashes, setup scripts, small fixtures, compatibility metadata, results
corpus_policy.forbidden_tracked: node_modules, database data dirs, archives, full third-party trees
corpus_policy.reconstruction: clean checkout + setup script must rebuild corpus from public repos

decision_rules.CONTINUE: useful coverage + setup<=5min median + zero wrappers/assertions + privacy gates pass + perf within thresholds
decision_rules.INSUFFICIENT_REAL_SERVICE_CORPUS: <8 genuinely eligible baseline-reproducible incidents under this boundary; do not fabricate
decision_rules.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: post-outcome corpus edits, per-bug capture changes, bug-specific oracles, fix-patch influence, library wrappers mislabeled as services, live deps satisfying replay
decision_rules.KILL: low coverage, routine per-bug adapters, unreliable replay, structural perf, privacy-vs-fidelity conflict, unsafe identity
decision_rules.MODIFY: thesis survives with narrower boundary or unresolved perf/privacy limit; state exact boundary

eligibility: observable via actual service HTTP request
runs on Node 22 without semantics-changing mods
fixed revision executable for disappearance check
excluded_allowed: cannot run on Node 22 without invasive changes

correctness: 0 live external effects in offline replay
artifact-only replay needs neither original capture nor live Postgres/HTTP

requirements: no single service p95 >35% without MODIFY

performance_methodology.repetitions: >=5 independent reps per mode; rotate order
performance_methodology.volume: >=5000 measured successful requests per mode per service unless impractical (report deviation)

privacy_gates: 0 raw secret leaks in attack suite
0 raw secret leaks in headline artifacts

privacy_policy.PII: redact/transform where raw value unnecessary; explicit policy, no compliance certification claim
privacy_policy.credentials_secrets: raw values never serialized into capture or artifact
privacy_policy.sensitive_but_required: classify explicitly; test equality-preserving deterministic surrogate; never silently persist raw

forbidden_shortcuts: hand-mocking the dependency capture should record
headline_must: independently existing public Node/TS app or backend service repo
real entry point or normal integration-test server path
actual business implementation with the bug
no experiment-authored node:http wrapper around a library function

reducer: frozen V1/V2 GREEDY, no algorithm changes for headline V3
screening_integrity: search broader pool than final corpus
record every seriously screened candidate + reason
baseline may be tested during screening
NO headline Rapture capture before corpus freeze

supported_boundary.auth: inbound auth/session observable; raw credentials never persist
supported_boundary.http: actual service HTTP entry on node:http-compatible stacks
out_of_scope: websocket/session replay beyond one bounded request
Mongo/MySQL/Redis as headline deps (exploratory cohort only)
supported_boundary.process_model: one app process per captured request

v2_preserved_caveats: headline corpus was library-level harnesses, not service repos
